title: The Kingdom of God
speaker: Pastor Samuel Isiko
description: Have you ever wondered the dynamics of the Kingdom of God, how the spiritual dominion is set up and what goes on in the spiritual dominion? Pastor Sam, unveils the mysteries hidden in the dynamics in the spiritual domains.  Ref: Daniel 10:12-13

title: WALKING IN THE POWER OF GOD
speaker: PR.ISIKO SAMUEL
description: knowing your position as a joint heir with Jesus Christ

title: Walking In The Power Of The Kingdom Press-In
speaker: Pr. Samuel Isiko

title: The Just Shall Live By Faith.
speaker: Pr. Isiko Sam
description: Live by faith and not by sight

title: The Just Shall Live By Faith part 2
speaker: Pr. Samuel Isiko
description: This sermon emphasizes that living by faith is a proactive lifestyle that transcends physical circumstances, requiring believers to see beyond the natural eye. Pr. Samuel Isiko teaches that true faith is manifested through the four pillars of conviction, meditation, confession, and corresponding actions.

title: What Is Faith?
speaker: Pr. Samuel Isiko
description: This sermon defines biblical faith as a deep, Spirit-led conviction rooted in the Word of God rather than human willpower or external circumstances.

title: Why Bad Things Happen To Good People
speaker: Ap. Niyonshima Ronald
description: This inspiring sermon explores the question, “Why do bad things happen to good people?” and reflects on the role of the human body (Omubiri) in our spiritual journey. Through biblical teaching and practical examples, the message encourages faith, endurance, and trust in God during life's challenges. A thought-provoking devotion that strengthens believers and points them toward hope, purpose, and a deeper relationship with Christ.

title: What You Need To Produce Faith
speaker: Pr.Sam Isiko
description: True faith grows when the word of God is planted in a prepared heart and nurtured by the Holy Spirit, enabling believers to overcome any challenge

title: Be The Doers Of The Word
speaker: Pr.Sam Isiko
description: The core message is that true faith must be expressed through action and the practical application of Scripture in daily life

title: No Place For The Double Minded People
speaker: Pr.Sam Isiko
description: The necessity of unwavering faith in God, warning against the spiritual danger of being "double-minded" or conflicted between belief and worldly circumstances

title: How To Cultivate Hard Hearts
speaker: Pr.Sam Isiko
description: Align your thinking with the word of God, following the guidance of Philippians 4:8. Focus on things that are true, honest, and worthy of praise, rather than dwelling on the torments or problems brought by the devil.
